svg.title: The changelog without conflicts
svg.desc: Two pull requests each add a file of their own to changelog.d, so they merge into main one after the other without a conflict. The release bot writes the section of the next release from the fragments and the text of Unreleased into CHANGELOG.md of the release pull request, and deletes the fragments in the same commit. Merging it makes that section the notes of the release. Until then, the website shows the entries of the fragments under Unreleased, and the fix bot renames a heading of a fragment that surely means a kind of change.
